note: Plumas NF campground in tall pine and fir on the east shore of Little Grass Valley Reservoir, about 5,000 ft up near La Porte. Paved spurs throughout. A seasonal host is on site. The six prime lakeside sites (16, 18, 20, 21, 23, 25) glimpse the lake through the trees; the shore is about 120 m off through forest. Boat ramp in the campground; the Lakeshore Trail circles the reservoir. --Claude
summary: FS page and alerts, rec.gov facility/rates/catalog/site photos, OSM, imagery and 3DEP read. Reservable on rec.gov, $23 ($25 prime lakeside), 14-night max, 8 people / 2 vehicles. 41 sites, 38 reservable, 35 with 24 ft+ spurs. Flush toilets and water confirmed; note-derived dump=false cleared. Closed for the season (normal); no alert. The old note's claim that 2026 reservations were suspended isn't on any current page and is dropped. Lakeview kept. Pin 292 m off at the entrance - re-pin.
flags: WATERFRONT (keep lakeview): the catalog tags 16, 18, 20, 21, 23, 25 'Lakefront' and FS sells them as 'prime lakeside' at $25, but site 18 (39.73724,-120.96920) and 16 (39.73746,-120.96902) sit ~110-120 m inside the forest from the high-water tree line (imagery), 181-191 m from the NHD outline and ~10 m above pool (3DEP 1548.5 m). Their 2021 photos show the lake only through pine trunks. Behind trees = view, so lakeview stays.

PIN MOVE (292 m): stored 39.73888,-120.96620 (= the FS lat/long, at the entrance road NE of the loops). Target 39.73684,-120.96833 (centroid of the 41 rec.gov site points). rec.gov's facility point 39.73528,-120.95306 is 1.3 km east and wrong. Elevation at the target 1569 m (Open-Meteo) vs stored 1592.
